DATA-AI-PLAT: Design a system that helps us bring all our data, pipelines, governance, analytics, and AI models onto one platform, so every team builds on the same trusted data.
DSPM: My agent needs a system to find sensitive data across our cloud stores and SaaS apps, see who can reach it, and fix risky access before it leaks.
EPM: I need a system to budget, forecast, and model scenarios in one place, so finance plans with driver-based numbers instead of spreadsheets.
HCMS: Set up a system that lets us manage our content once and deliver it through APIs to every website, app, and channel.
KGP: My agent needs a system to model our business as a connected knowledge graph that our apps can query and reason over.
LCAP: We need a tool to design and run custom business applications visually, without writing code.
RE-INVEST: Our team needs software to run our real estate funds end to end: underwrite acquisitions, value the portfolio, call capital, distribute returns, and report to investors.
REAL-EST: Set up a system that lets us manage our properties, leases, workplaces, and building operations from one place.
SAM: Can you build us something to know every software license we own, match it to what is installed, and be ready for every vendor audit?
UEM: Design a system that helps us enroll, configure, and secure every laptop, phone, and tablet we own, across all operating systems.
WFM: Help me build an app to schedule shifts, track time and attendance, manage leave, and forecast labor while staying compliant with labor law.
